findings.description: At 00:00-00:02 every olive source in frame (small bowl in hand, metal bowl, ceramic bowl) contains only green olives, and only green olives are shown falling into the jar. After the jump cut, the jar's bottom layer at 00:04 contains numerous dark-purple olives mixed with the green. No dark olives are ever visible in any source bowl before this point, nor is any dark olive shown being added, so a large share of the jar's contents has no traceable origin.

findings.entity: small clear glass bottle on counter between metal bowl and ceramic bowl
findings.description: From 00:06 onward a small clear glass bottle stands on the countertop between the metal bowl and the ceramic bowl. That same counter area is visible and empty in shots 1-2 (00:00-00:04), and no person is ever shown setting the bottle down; it appears across the cut to the higher camera-left angle. Elapsed time across the cut could hide a placement, but no supporting action or repositioning of the man is shown.
